title: tanacetum vahlii var. subflosculosum
intro: Tanacetum vahlii var. subflosculosum, commonly known as Himalayan tansy, is a plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Himalayan tansy include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments.
